Neo Corporate Public Company Limited 12Karakuri Kaizen
Karakuri  Kaizen  is an activity  in the manufacturing  industry  in which  all 
employees  are encouraged  to participate  in initiating  creative  ideas  to improve  
production  line efficiency,  based  on ideas  from  employees  who  regularly  perform  on-
site production  work . Karakuri  Kaizen  utilizes gravity, inclined planes, rollers,
pendulums, orsprings , all of which  do not use components  or equipment  that require  
electrical  power  to drive  the mechanism  in any manner .
In the industrial  sector,  the implementation  of Karakuri  Kaizen  in manufacturing  
facilities  can help reduce energy consumption and lower production costs, while also
improving operational efficiency .Therefore,  the adoption  of Karakuri  Kaizen,  which  is 
low-cost  automation  equipment  with  simple  mechanical  mechanisms  based  on 
mechanical  principles  such  as gravity,  aims  to eliminate  waste  in processes  and 
reduce  process  complexity .
Karakuri  Kaizen  also  requires low construction and maintenance costs, helps  
conserve  resources,  and enhances  employee  safety . At present,  it has been  widely  
applied  in the manufacturing  industry,  and its application  has been  extended  to 
various  business  sectors  as well.
Source: NECTEC: National Electronics And Computer Technology Center

related parties.
4) Ensure transparency for whistleblowers by keep reporters informed 
of the case status throughout the process.
